snippet.title: TapKick 2014 6 second Trailer
snippet.description:
TapKick World cup 2014 is our "Summer freebie 2014" !
With a simple one-tap gameplay, everyone can compete in this World cup tournament!  Pick one of the 32 competing countries, and see if you can be the best of the best

Challenge your friends and challenge the global leaderboards!
